content:
Apple TV is getting into the festive spirit early, announcing today the debut of two brand-new holiday specials, plus a free viewing offer for several beloved Peanuts titles. Here are the details:

New Snoopy and Ted Lasso holiday specials, a Chris Pratt family film, and more are coming to Apple TV

This year, Apple is debuting two new holiday specials, both from beloved classic franchises:

  • Snoopy Presents: A Snoopy Twelve Days of Christmas premieres Friday, November 13
  • Ted Lasso: The Holiday Gift arrives Friday, December 4

Each new title will join the existing Peanuts and Ted Lasso libraries already streaming on Apple TV.

Along with the announcement of its new specials, Apple TV's press release also highlighted a new family film, Way of the Warrior Kid. Starring Chris Pratt and Linda Cardellini, the film premieres Wednesday, November 25. While it's not technically a holiday title, Apple likes to release new family movies around Thanksgiving each year. Here's the synopsis:

In addition to this year's new releases, Apple is also making several beloved Peanuts holiday specials free to watch later this year on designated weekends. The dates are as follows:

  • It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown: October 17–18
  • A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving: November 14–15
  • A Charlie Brown Christmas: December 12–13

Apple TV subscribers can stream the specials anytime throughout the year, but they'll be free for everyone on the dates listed above.

Some of my personal holiday recommendations also include the Apple Music+ comedy Spirited (starring Ryan Reynolds and Will Ferrell), and Hannah Waddingham: Home for Christmas, a must-see for Ted Lasso fans.

What's your favorite holiday special on Apple TV? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV starts at $14.99/month, or you can bundle it with other Apple services for a discount via Apple One.
